developability.method: deterministic rule panels computed from RDKit descriptors

solubility.flag: [UNVERIFIED-COEFFICIENTS] literature equation transcribed without source access
solubility.caveat: ordering heuristic only; not calibrated on a local measured set

cns.flag: [UNVERIFIED-COEFFICIENTS] literature equation transcribed without source access
cns.caveat: no pKa model on this host, so the logD term is a cLogP-1 proxy; use for ordering CNS-likeness only

liabilities.herg_flag_basis: basic tertiary amine motif together with cLogP > 3 (a coarse triage flag, not a hERG model)
liabilities.method: SMARTS substructure alerts; no trained toxicity model is bundled

data.disclaimer: rule panels are COMPUTED; solubility and CNS scores are literature equations with unverified constants and no local calibration
